title: Add quality gate state machine + persistence for Optimize config changes
author: Michael Nguyen
description: This PR introduces the Quality Gate Run state machine and persistence layer in the Optimize service. Optimize recommendations (batching/caching/quantization profile changes) will be required to attach a gate run before they can be applied to production, but this PR only implements the core data model + transition logic + initial API endpoints (wiring to eval-harness and Console happens in follow-ups). The state machine is intentionally strict and idempotent to support retries, partial failures, and eventual coupling to rollout promotion. Includes DB migrations, internal admin endpoints, and notes for backfilling existing recommendations with `gate_required=false` until policy enforcement lands.
commits: optimize: add GateRun domain model + transition validators
api: add create/get/list gate run endpoints behind feature flag
ops: add stuck-run reaper + metrics for state transitions
api_summary: New endpoints (behind `optimize_quality_gates_enabled`): POST /internal/optimize/v1/quality-gates/runs (create a gate run for a config-diff + baseline ref; returns gate_run_id + initial state=PENDING), GET /internal/optimize/v1/quality-gates/runs/{gate_run_id} (read model + latest state + timestamps), GET /internal/optimize/v1/quality-gates/runs?recommendation_id=... (list runs for a recommendation). State transition endpoints are intentionally NOT exposed yet; transitions happen via internal workers (future: eval-harness callbacks) using the repository methods with optimistic concurrency.
data_model_notes: Adds `quality_gate_runs` (one row per run) and `quality_gate_run_events` (append-only event log). `quality_gate_runs` fields include: gate_run_id (uuid), recommendation_id, config_diff_hash, baseline_ref, tier (SMOKE|FULL), state, state_reason_code, created_by, created_at, started_at, completed_at, expires_at (for overrides), last_heartbeat_at, attempt_count. `quality_gate_run_events` records every transition with actor_type (system|user), actor_id, from_state, to_state, reason_code, message, created_at. Event log is designed to be audit-friendly and to support future Console views.
state_machine: States: PENDING -> RUNNING -> PASSED | FAILED. Terminal/exception states: CANCELED (from PENDING/RUNNING), OVERRIDDEN (from FAILED only, time-bound via expires_at). Allowed transitions are validated centrally in GateRunStateMachine with reason codes required for FAILED/OVERRIDDEN/CANCELED. Idempotency: repeated transitions to the current state are treated as no-ops if reason_code/message match, otherwise rejected with 409 to prevent silent overwrites.
migration_notes: Migration applies two new tables. No backfill required. Existing recommendations continue to work because enforcement is not enabled in this PR; the Optimize apply path will consult policy in a later PR and treat missing gate runs as allowed only when `gate_required=false` for the route/tier. Rollback: safe to roll back application code after migration; tables will remain unused. Local dev: run `pnpm db:migrate` (or `make optimize-migrate`) and ensure `OPTIMIZE_QUALITY_GATES_ENABLED=true` to hit the new endpoints.
operational_notes: Includes a lightweight reaper job that marks RUNNING gate runs as FAILED with reason_code=RUN_TIMEOUT if `last_heartbeat_at` is stale for > 45m (configurable). This prevents stuck runs from blocking later policy enforcement. Emits counters for transitions and a gauge for in-flight RUNNING runs (names to be finalized in ENG-3926).
conversation: Jordan Lee: Can we guarantee we never end up with two concurrent RUNNING runs for the same recommendation/config diff? Michael Nguyen: Added a unique constraint on (recommendation_id, config_diff_hash, tier) for non-terminal states and create endpoint now returns existing gate_run_id when the same idempotency key is reused. Benji Okafor: Please document the reason codes and enforce them at the boundary. Michael Nguyen: Added enum + validator; failing transitions must provide one of: QUALITY_REGRESSION, EVAL_ERROR, INFRA_TIMEOUT, RUN_TIMEOUT, USER_CANCELED, OVERRIDE_APPROVED. Chloe Martin: The GET endpoint should include latest event metadata for UI summaries later. Michael Nguyen: Added `latest_event_at` and `state_reason_code`/`state_message` on the run record so consumers don’t need to join events for the common case. Sean Gallagher: 45m seems high for timeouts; we’ll need separate thresholds for smoke vs full gates. Michael Nguyen: Tier-specific timeout added (SMOKE 15m, FULL 45m) behind config; default values can be tuned without redeploy. Paula Mendes: Make sure OVERRIDDEN is time-bound; do not allow “forever overrides”. Michael Nguyen: OVERRIDDEN requires expires_at (max 7 days) and actor_type=user; system cannot override. Paula Mendes: Approver auth? Michael Nguyen: This PR only adds the data model; the override endpoint is not implemented here. OVERRIDDEN can only be set through repository in internal admin tooling for now, protected by existing admin RBAC. Follow-up PR will introduce a proper approval flow + audit events.
